posts.caption:
5 PLANS FOR YOUR CALGARY WEEKEND 🔥

1. Night Light — Victoria Park · Sat 6 to 11 pm · free
2. Maria Bamford — Bella Concert Hall · Sat 5 and 8 pm
3. Where Dark Things Dwell escape room — Heritage Park · Sat 7:30 pm, Sun 7 pm
4. Wordfest presents R. F. Kuang — Bella Concert Hall · Sun 1 pm
5. Olympic Oval 39th birthday skate — Sun 3 to 8 pm

Tag who you're bringing. Full list at the link in bio.

Dates checked with each organizer. Photo: Colby Stopa, CC BY 2.0.
